page_title: RBL 2-1 HAM | RB Leipzig v Hamburger SV 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Tobias Welz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' The expression of the referee Tobias Welz is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) is shown a yellow card.
90+4' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+4' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+1' Substitution. Nicolas Capaldo will be replaced by Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger).
90+1' Romulo Cardoso comes off the pitch to be replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
90' Here's the change. Rayan Philippe leaves the pitch and Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) comes on as a substitute.
90' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) replaces Antonio Nusa.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
86' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
84' Substitution. Fabio Balde (Hamburger) on for William Mikelbrencis.

84' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
81' 9:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
79' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is yellow-carded.
78' That's the end of the game for Christoph Baumgartner, who is replaced by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
78' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer is replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger).
76' It will be a substitution. Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger) is ready to enter the pitch as Albert Sambi Lokonga walks off.

76' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.

71' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
68' Half-chance! Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) plays a pass into the box, but Peter Gulacsi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.
65' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Hamburger SV win a free kick.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hamburger SV comes to nothing.
61' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) replacing Johan Bakayoko.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is brought on as a substitute for Assan Ouedraogo.
60' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. RB Leipzig are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
59' RB Leipzig enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
57' A pass from Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is intercepted by Peter Gulacsi and the move breaks down.

50' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
48' 1 - 1 Goal! Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:1.
48' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Antonio Nusa and planted his close-range header into the right side of the goal. Daniel Heuer Fernandes was helpless.
43' The referee gives a yellow card to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
40' The RB Leipzig players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
36' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) is penalised for holding. Tobias Welz signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig.

33' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
33' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) prepares to take a corner kick.

32' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hamburger SV are going to take it.
32' Hamburger SV seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Welz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
25' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

25' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
23' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
22' Hamburger SV can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hamburger SV.
21' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

20' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
18' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) picks up a yellow card.
17' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' The foul by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) was seen by Tobias Welz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
14' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
11' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement. RB Leipzig earn a free kick.
8' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes.

5' David Raum (RB Leipzig) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
4' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comfortably gathers the ball.
1' A pass from Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is intercepted by Peter Gulacsi and the move breaks down.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Tobias Welz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
